title: Operation Prato as an official armed forces operation

tellings.quote: The operation took place. It was an official operation led by the armed forces to monitor these phenomena in the state of PA.

plain: In 1977, Brazil's armed forces ran an official operation, known as Operation Prato, to watch for strange phenomena in the skies over the northern state of Pará. That is the account of Aldo Rebelo, a Brazilian politician the episode presents as a former defence minister. He tells Michels plainly: "The operation took place. It was an official operation led by the armed forces to monitor these phenomena." He points to the operation's own report as his basis, though he gives none of its words here. Coming from someone who once ran Brazil's defence ministry, that statement treats the military's interest as a matter of record.
